name: search_scholar
description: Search Google Scholar for scientific papers with citation counts
usage: from app.tools.biomni.literature import search_scholar; result = search_scholar('BRCA1 breast cancer mutations', max_results=10)

parameters.query: str — search query (supports operators like author:, source:)

returns: dict with keys: query, total, papers (list of {title, authors, year, abstract, citations, url})
